---
applyTo: "**/*.md"
---

Treat `/AGENTS.md` and `.ai/UPDATE_PROTOCOL.md` as the documentation contract. Keep canonical truth in `.ai/` and shared workflow in `AGENTS.md`; keep tool-specific adapters short.

Do not hand-edit `docs/agent/repository-index.md`; regenerate it with `python scripts/refresh_agent_index.py`.
